smallerGuideBtn.what: Scales the shape of every guide down a bit (x0.75). Positions do not change.
examples: Click it when guides hide a small character.
Shrink guides on a mouse character.
smallerGuideBtn.details: Scales the CVs of the guide shapes (*_Guide ..._CtrlShape) x0.75; transforms do not move.

biggerGuideBtn.what: Scales the shape of every guide up a bit (x1.25). Positions do not change.
examples: Click it when guides are too small to pick.
Grow guides on a giant.
biggerGuideBtn.details: Scales the CVs of the guide shapes x1.25; transforms do not move.

smallerCtrlsBtn.what: Scales the shape of every controller down (x0.75).
examples: Click it when ctrls cover the face.
Shrink ctrls on a small prop.
smallerCtrlsBtn.details: Scales the CVs of every *_Ctrl shape x0.75 around its pivot. A rebuild keeps it (ctrl shapes are saved).

biggerCtrlsBtn.what: Scales the shape of every controller up (x1.25).
examples: Click it when ctrls are hidden inside the mesh.
Grow ctrls for a big creature.
biggerCtrlsBtn.details: Scales the CVs of every *_Ctrl shape x1.25 around its pivot.

scale_guides_button.what: Scales the Mutant guide template by the number in the field.
examples: Type 0.5 and click it to fit the guides on a small creature.
Type 2 to fit a template to a tall character.
scale_guides_button.details: Scales the children of Mutant_Build by the value. Errors if there is no Mutant_Build or more than one.

ShowAxisBtn.what: Shows the local axis of the selected joints, or of every joint if nothing is selected.
examples: Check that the arm joints point down the bone.
Check finger orients before building.
ShowAxisBtn.details: displayLocalAxis 1 on the selected joints, or on every joint when no joint is selected.

HideAxisBtn.what: Hides the local axis of the selected joints, or of every joint.
examples: Clean the viewport after checking orients.
Hide them for a clean playblast.
HideAxisBtn.details: displayLocalAxis 0 on the selected joints, or on every joint.

lockContainerBtn.what: Puts the rig nodes back in their containers so animators can't select the inside of the rig.
examples: Lock them before publishing.
Lock before handing the rig over.
lockContainerBtn.details: Puts the nodes listed in RigTools.settings (Maya user script folder) back into the rig containers.

unlockContainerBtn.what: Takes the nodes out of the rig containers so you can edit them.
examples: Open them to fix a node, then Lock Containers.
Open to fix a node inside the rig.
unlockContainerBtn.details: Takes the rig nodes out of their containers and writes the list to RigTools.settings, so Lock can put them back.

help_button.what: Opens the online help for the visemes tools.
examples: Watch how to make the mouth shapes.
Read how to set up visemes.

keyVisemes.what: Keys the mouth ctrls through the viseme poses (AEI, OUW, FV, BMP, CDN), 10 frames apart.
steps: Adjust each viseme pose on its frame.
examples: Click it, then pose each viseme frame.
Key the visemes for a lip sync test.
keyVisemes.details: Deletes keys, then keys the lip ctrls for AEI, OUW, FV, BMP, CDN 10 frames apart, scaled by the multiplier.

bakeVisemes.what: Select the head geo: duplicates it at each viseme frame into a Visemes group.
examples: Click it once the poses look right.
Bake the visemes into shapes for a game rig.
bakeVisemes.details: Duplicates each selected geo at the viseme frames (10, 30...) into a Visemes group: <geo>_AEI, _OUW...

splitVisemes.what: Opens the SHAPES tool to split the viseme shapes.
examples: Split each viseme into left and right.
Split visemes for asymmetrical mouths.

load_blendshapes.tip: List the blendshapes of the selected head.
load_blendshapes.what: Fills the list with the blendShape nodes on the selected head geo.
examples: Select the head and click <<.
List the blendshapes on the head.
load_blendshapes.details: Lists the blendShape nodes in the history of the selected geo.

connectVisemes.what: Connects the viseme shapes of the chosen blendShape node to the rig.
examples: Pick the blendShape and click it.
Connect the baked visemes to the rig.
connectVisemes.details: Connects the rig viseme attrs to the AEI / OUW / FV / BMP / CDN targets of the chosen blendShape (missing targets are skipped).

HideBtn.tip: Hide the checked attrs on the selection.
HideBtn.what: Locks and hides translate / rotate / scale / visibility (the checked ones) on the selected objects.
examples: Hide scale on every FK ctrl so animators don't scale them.
Hide visibility on ctrls so animators do not key it.
HideBtn.details: ShowHideAttr.hideSelection(T, R, S, V): lock + hide (keyable off) the checked channels on the selection.

RevealBtn.what: Unlocks and shows all the attrs hidden on the selection.
examples: Get back an attr you hid by mistake.
Reveal attrs to debug a rig.
RevealBtn.details: ShowHideAttr.showAll(): unlock and show every channel on the selection.

SimpleFKBtn.tip: Make an FK chain on the selected joints.
SimpleFKBtn.what: Creates FK ctrls on the selected joints with the size, color and shape set below.
examples: Select the tail joints and click it.
Make an FK chain on antennas.
SimpleFKBtn.details: mt.fk_chain(size, color, curve_type) on the selected joints: a ctrl with root group per joint, each parented to the previous one.

code.connect: lambda: mt.fk_chain(size = self.ui.SimpleFKSizeSlider.value(), color = self.ui.SimpleFKColorBox.currentText(), curve_type = self.ui.SimpleFKShapeBox.currentText())

TubeFKBtn.tip: Make an FK chain from vertices.
TubeFKBtn.what: Select edge loops or vertices of a tube: makes clusters and an FK chain along it.
steps: Select one edge loop per joint, in order.
Turn on flip if the chain comes out reversed.
examples: Rig a cable or a tentacle in seconds.
Make an FK chain along a hose.
TubeFKBtn.details: One cluster per selected component group, joints at their centers, then an FK chain on them.

auto_rotate_fk.tip: Rotate a chain with one ctrl.
auto_rotate_fk.what: Select ctrls in order: makes one new ctrl that rotates all of them together.
examples: Curl a whole tail with one ctrl.
Curl all fingers with one ctrl.
auto_rotate_fk.details: Builds an FK chain on the selection with scale, then mt.create_auto rotate: one new ctrl adds its rotation to every ctrl (twist axis Y).

dynamic_fk_btn.what: Creates an FK chain with dynamics so it follows through on its own.
examples: Add jiggle to a ponytail.
Add follow through to a tail.
dynamic_fk_btn.details: mt.create_dynamic_fk(): hair system driven chain blended over the FK.

connect_to_scale_reader.tip: Connect the selection to the scale reader.
connect_to_scale_reader.what: Connects the rig scale reader to the selected delta mush or nodes, so they scale with the rig.
examples: Select a delta mush that blurs when scaled, click it.
Fix a deltaMush that blurs when the rig scales.
connect_to_scale_reader.details: deltaMush selected: connects scale_reader.sx/sy/sz into it. Anything else: scaleConstraint from scale_reader.

soft_cluster.tip: Make a cluster from the soft selection.
soft_cluster.what: Creates a cluster with the weights of your soft selection.
examples: Soft select a cheek area and click it to get a cheek puff cluster.
Make a soft cluster for a belly breathing.
soft_cluster.details: Reads the rich (soft) selection with OpenMaya and makes a cluster with those weights.

rivet_on_face.tip: Pin the selection to a mesh face.
rivet_on_face.what: Creates a rivet on the selected face so an object can follow the mesh.
examples: Select a face on the chest and click it to pin a badge.
Pin buttons to a shirt.
rivet_on_face.details: mt.rivet_constraint(selection): a rivet (follicle / uvPin style) on the selected face that follows the deformed mesh.
